descripcion: F3 · Wheel: un paso por gesto, inercia del trackpad filtrada, cola de 1.

steps.eval: (() => { const root=document.querySelector('[data-mode]'); window.__log=[]; new MutationObserver(()=>{ const e=[root.dataset.active, root.dataset.mode]; const l=__log[__log.length-1]; if(!l||l.join()!==e.join()) __log.push(e) }).observe(root,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['data-active','data-mode']}); window.__take=()=>__log.splice(0); window.__sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); window.__wheel=async (seq,ms=16)=>{ const t=document.elementFromPoint(innerWidth/2, innerHeight/2); for (const d of seq){ t.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel',{deltaY:d,bubbles:true,cancelable:true})); await __sleep(ms) } }; window.__trackpad=(peak=60,n=90)=>{ const s=[]; for(let i=0;i<8;i++) s.push(Math.round(peak*(i+1)/8)); let x=peak; for(let i=0;i<n;i++){ x*=0.95; s.push(Math.max(1,Math.round(x))) } return s }; return root.dataset.mode })()
(async () => { const a=__trackpad(60,90), b=__trackpad(70,60); await __wheel([...a.slice(0,40), ...b]); await __sleep(2600); return __take() })()
steps.label: C 2.º swipe sobre la inercia → encolado

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i=0;i<3;i++) { await __wheel([-100]); await __sleep(250) } await __sleep(2400); return __take() })()
